text:
zoe_sales: Quick sync  SolsticeHealth needs a compliance packet to unblock their PO. They asked for: redacted SOC2 control-matrix excerpt, signed pen-test attestation for our staging cluster (addressed to their CISO), and a quick on-prem VM vs hosted POC delta estimate. Can we turn this around by Friday? @matt_se @sara_compliance @ravi_security

matt_se: I can scope the on-prem delta. Clarify format: OVA or tarball? Packaging + validation differs. Ballpark now: $10k one-time for OVA packaging/validation, $1.8k/mo support. Pentest coordination add ~$1k. I'll confirm later today.

sara_compliance: For SOC2 we can extract the control-matrix pages and the scope page. We'll redact hostnames, usernames, and internal ticket IDs. Need ~24 hours to create redacted PDFs and sign.

ravi_security: Pen-test attestation: we can provide a letter confirming an accredited third-party tested the isolated staging environment. We won't include vuln details. If Solstice wants to run their vendor, require an NDA addendum + POA from Legal and a 2-4 hour maintenance window. That adds ~2 business days.

zoe_sales: They want the attestation on letterhead and addressed to "CISO, SolsticeHealth". Also asked if CIDR can be in the letter.

ravi_security: Prefer not to embed IPs/CIDRs in a signed public letter. Use "CIDR available upon NDA" and provide it out-of-band after Legal review. If they insist on CIDR in the signed letter, Legal must review.

evidence-bot: Created ticket EVID-8001: SolsticeHealth proofpack. Checklist: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test attestation, NDA addendum template, network isolation diagram. Owner: zoe_sales.

matt_se: Tiny ASCII diagram for the packet:

```
Internet -> LB -> Bastion (jumpbox) -> Isolated Staging VPC
No peering with production; management plane on separate subnet.
```

ravi_security: Draft attestation snippet for Legal review:

```
[Redwood Inference Letterhead]
To: CISO, SolsticeHealth
Re: Penetration Test Attestation  Staging Environment
Redwood Inference confirms that an accredited third-party performed a penetration test focused on the isolated staging environment used for the SolsticeHealth POC. The assessment was limited to the staging cluster and related ingress points. Detailed vulnerability reports and remediation details are withheld; a high-level summary may be provided under NDA. This attestation does not grant authorization to access production systems.
Signed,
[Director of Security]
```

zoe_sales: Next steps: Matt  final on-prem delta by EOD; Sara  redacted SOC2 by tomorrow AM; Ravi  route attestation to Legal for sign-off today. I'll feed procurement a nonbinding estimate to avoid delay. Thanks team :thumbsup:
